sections.name: CiteCell
sections.title: Clickable cell wrapper
sections.what: A button wrapper that calls the handler on click and shows its content with a dotted underline and a hover tip.
sections.why: Likely reason: makes cited values look clickable.
sections.watch_out: The hover tip text is fixed in English.

summary: A small clickable table cell that opens the full citation behind a value.
purpose: Lets a table value open its source.
why: Likely reason: keeps the table simple while the citation work happens elsewhere.
how: Wraps the cell content in a plain button that calls the handler it is given, styled with a dotted underline and a hover tip.
inputs: A click handler, the content to show, and a test id.
outputs: A clickable looking value that calls the handler.
risks: Nothing happens on click unless the parent passes a real handler.
debug: If clicking does nothing, check the handler the parent passes in.
